fields.Evidence expectations: A small checked example, exact relevant baseline and direct authorised conversation can suffice.
fields.Failure conditions: Hidden supported consumers or a newly consequential change defeats the local scope.
fields.Name: Small stable single product
Required mechanisms: Direct understanding of actual obligations and interfaces
One relevant outcome/alternative check when a real decision arises
fields.Transition or retirement path: Remain unchanged while useful; move to bounded maintenance or a family only when actual need and cost justify it.
fields.Triggers: One product, few consequential boundaries, adequate current support and no justified family investment.

fields.Evidence expectations: Change-specific understanding, supported-observer checks and applicable post-change observations.
fields.Failure conditions: Scope escapes, stale mapping, unknown intent or infeasible promised repair require a bounded interruption.
fields.Name: Continuing modular single-product maintenance
Required mechanisms: Relevant rationale, actual-candidate evidence and recovery
fields.Transition or retirement path: Retain local work; broaden coordination only at shared consequences; phase into servicing or retirement if justified.
fields.Triggers: A long-lived product has recurring changes and useful modular/shared-interface boundaries without a product family.

fields.Evidence expectations: Concrete comparison of support/coordination costs, affected products and relevant shared changes.
fields.Failure conditions: Untracked divergence or assumed shared assurance that does not apply to an exceptional product.
fields.Name: Selective reuse or traceable clone-and-own
fields.Transition or retirement path: Consolidate selectively when observed recurring cost warrants it, or separate further while preserving actual obligations.
fields.Triggers: Some genuine common assets exist but a full managed-family investment is not justified.

fields.Evidence expectations: Separate constraint adequacy, generator/realisation evidence and applicable product/family assurance.
fields.Failure conditions: Requested selection mistaken for realised identity, unmodelled build variation or inherited guarantee applied beyond its scope.
fields.Name: Managed static or generated family
Omitted mechanisms: Automatic use of every solver, sampling or family-analysis strategy
Required mechanisms: Version-related production inputs and actual-product acceptance
fields.Transition or retirement path: Use prospective economic review to simplify, split, restrict variants or move to servicing.
fields.Triggers: Repeated related products and support economics justify coordinated assets and derivation.

fields.Evidence expectations: Actual transfer, configuration migration and residual-consumer evidence at consequential steps.
fields.Failure conditions: Endpoint-only validation, absent data reconciliation, unfunded coexistence or missing repair route.
fields.Name: Incremental portfolio consolidation or architectural migration
Omitted mechanisms: A universal ban on atomic cutover
Required mechanisms: Explicit supported mixed states and data authority
fields.Transition or retirement path: Complete only on a residual-obligation witness; use quiescent cutover, stop consolidation or retain justified separation when necessary.
fields.Triggers: Existing independent products or architectures have useful consolidation opportunities and viable transfer seams.

fields.Evidence expectations: Each claimed compatibility or shared assurance result identifies the participating products and organisational reach.
fields.Failure conditions: Internal derivation authority is extrapolated to autonomous participants or conflicting obligations are hidden.
fields.Name: Decentralised family or independently owned ecosystem
Required mechanisms: Real scoped contribution and acceptance rights
fields.Transition or retirement path: Split over-centralised arrangements, narrow shared contracts or end coordination when its actual consumers disappear.
fields.Triggers: Independent owners share interfaces or assets but have not delegated universal product or release control.

fields.Evidence expectations: Practical support and actual repair capability, not lifecycle labels or age alone.
fields.Failure conditions: A promised support path is infeasible, or servicing is used to conceal unowned obligations.
fields.Name: Restricted servicing with supported older baselines
Omitted mechanisms: Assumed irreversible loss of future evolution
Required mechanisms: Honest supported versions and willing capacity
Bounded repairs and relevant compatibility checks
fields.Transition or retirement path: Reassess actual revival feasibility, transfer support, or retire responsibly; do not infer impossibility from the stage label.
fields.Triggers: A useful product or family remains supportable for limited repair while broader evolution is not currently justified.

fields.Evidence expectations: Observed closure and separate successful retrieval or reproduction of what is deliberately retained.
fields.Failure conditions: A declaration of completion hides older consumers, data authority, recovery use or unavailable archives.
fields.Name: Retirement, consolidation and purpose-specific preservation
Omitted mechanisms: Permanent live operation solely to preserve history
Required mechanisms: Verified closure or transfer of operative paths
Explicit historical retrieval/execution purpose where retained
Separate old-product support and new-product admission decisions
fields.Transition or retirement path: Terminate each mechanism at its own justified boundary; reclassify warranted continuing coexistence honestly.
fields.Triggers: Prospective value/support no longer justifies continued service or variability, subject to residual obligations.

fields.Evidence expectations: A valid observation/plant/action envelope and evidence of consequential reachable-state obligations.
fields.Failure conditions: Lost observer validity, uncontrolled events, incompatible controller interaction or an unavailable promised repair route.
fields.Name: Bounded runtime-variable family
Omitted mechanisms: Assumption that endpoint validity proves transition safety
Supervisory synthesis where its plant assumptions do not hold
fields.Transition or retirement path: Interrupt unsupported actions, enter a separately justified safe phase, bind earlier or return to authorised operator control.
fields.Triggers: A real runtime need outweighs earlier binding or restart alternatives and adequate observation/control is feasible.

fields.Evidence expectations: Precisely scoped proofs/analyses plus needed correspondence and environmental observations; preserve formal exclusions.
fields.Failure conditions: Model drift, unsupported feature language, missing controllability or an unjustified lift to global progress.
fields.Name: High-assurance architectural or family subset
Omitted mechanisms: Assumption that a solver gives operational permission
Required mechanisms: Separate model, engine and implementation evidence
Restriction of unsupported configurations or transitions
fields.Transition or retirement path: Narrow the modelled subset, choose a different transition strategy or use cheaper adequate evidence when the protected concern ends.
fields.Triggers: A material property has tractable formal semantics and the implementation/environment mapping can be checked.

fields.Evidence expectations: Representative isolatable exposure or an explicit containment rationale; observation must discriminate and reach someone able to act.
fields.Failure conditions: Shared state defeats isolation, telemetry is absent, or temporary degradation silently becomes indefinite unowned support.
fields.Name: Bounded emergency or staged live intervention
Omitted mechanisms: Requirement to migrate every product together
Required mechanisms: Identifiable actual exposed products and baselines
fields.Transition or retirement path: Expand only on applicable evidence, stop or repair adverse effects, and close/reclassify the temporary arrangement on its own obligations.
fields.Triggers: Urgent containment or production-only uncertainty warrants a genuinely bounded live action.

encoding: Repeated exact values use $scientific_ref, resolved through shared-records.json definitions. References preserve every value; they do not create scientific evidence.
